Ordinary run steps for travel paperwork
This page teaches the order of work
Companion Animal Travel Desk operations keep animal travel smooth, safe, and clear for every customer. New staff handle paperwork first because later airport checks rely on it. A steady process reduces delays, avoids missed handoffs, and helps the cabin team monitor each animal without confusion.

Start with the booking file and confirm that the traveler, the animal, and the route details match across every record. <<FACT F091>> Then check whether the animal can travel on the planned service, whether the carrier meets standard limits, and whether any supporting documents are present. Keep your tone calm and direct when speaking with customers, because clear guidance prevents repeat calls and incorrect submissions.

When the paperwork is ready, review the arrival pickup details with care. <<FACT F089>> Compare the pickup notes with the journey record so the ground team receives the same instructions as the passenger. If a detail is missing, pause the file and request the correction before release. Do not guess, and do not pass a file that still has gaps.

For special cases, move slowly and document the reason for each decision. A pet traveling with extra support may need closer coordination with the cabin team and the arrival desk. Use plain language in every note, keep entries complete, and avoid shorthand that another colleague may not understand. If you receive a change from the traveler, update the record at once and confirm that every linked step still fits.

Your job is not only to process forms. It is also to keep the traveler informed, protect the animal's welfare, and make sure Aurelia Skyways can carry out the journey without avoidable trouble. Be prompt, respectful, and accurate in every exchange.

Remember the order, check the details, and release each file only when the full record is ready.
